help.here.town: You are inside a town, castle or village.
help.here.dungeon: You are deep in a dungeon.
help.here.combat: A fight is on: each party member acts in turn.
help.here.title: The game has not started yet: these are the overworld commands.
help.move.world: Walk, ride or sail one square (a ship sails only with the bow forward).
help.move.town: Walk one square; leave by the edge of the map.
help.move.dungeon: Up: step forward · Down: step back · Left/Right: turn.
help.move.combat: Move the active member one square; leave the field by an edge.
help.allIntro: Every command, by its original key. Where a command does something different depending on the place, each case is listed.
help.desc.pass: Let a turn go by without doing anything.
help.desc.pass.combat: End this member's turn without acting.
help.desc.attack: Attack a creature or person next to you (then pick a direction).
help.desc.attack.combat: Strike, shoot or throw at a foe in a direction with the readied weapon.
help.desc.board: Mount the horse or board the ship or balloon you are standing on.
help.desc.cast: Cast a spell you have mixed: choose the caster, then the spell's letter.
help.desc.cast.combat: Cast a mixed spell as this member's action.
help.desc.descend: Go down a ladder, or let the balloon land.
help.desc.descend.dungeon: Take a ladder down to the next level.
help.desc.enter: Enter the town, castle, dungeon or shrine you are standing on.
help.desc.fire: Fire the ship's cannons to one side.
help.desc.getChest: Open a chest at your feet. Taking what is not yours costs virtue, and chests may be trapped.
help.desc.getChest.dungeon: Open a chest in the square you are in (beware of traps).
help.desc.holeUp: Camp to rest and heal (overworld, on foot). You might be ambushed.
help.desc.ignite.dungeon: Light a torch to see further down the corridors.
help.desc.jimmy: Pick a locked door next to you with a key.
help.desc.klimb: Climb up a ladder, or make the balloon rise.
help.desc.klimb.dungeon: Take a ladder up to the level above, or out of the dungeon.
help.desc.locate: Read your position with a sextant.
help.desc.mix: Prepare doses of a spell from reagents, before casting it.
help.desc.newOrder: Swap two members in the marching order.
help.desc.open: Open a door next to you.
help.desc.peer: Look into a gem to see a map of the surroundings.
help.desc.peer.dungeon: Look into a gem to see the map of this level.
help.desc.quitSave: Save the game. Only possible on the overworld.
help.desc.ready: Choose the weapon a member holds.
help.desc.ready.combat: Change this member's weapon (uses the turn).
help.desc.search: Search the spot where you stand for something hidden.
help.desc.search.dungeon: Search the square you are in.
help.desc.talk: Speak to someone next to you (pick a direction; works across a counter).
help.desc.use: Use a special item you carry.
help.desc.use.combat: Use an item during the fight.
help.desc.wear: Change the armour a member wears.
help.desc.exit: Leave your horse, ship or balloon.
help.desc.yell: On horseback: spur the horse to a gallop, or slow it down.
help.desc.ztats: Show the party: members, equipment, reagents and items.
help.desc.volume: Turn the sound effects on or off.
help.ctl.keys.desc: The original commands, one key each (see the other sections).
help.ctl.arrows.desc: Move; in dungeons, step forward/back and turn. Also answer directions ("which way?").
help.ctl.enterEsc.desc: Enter confirms a typed answer or goes on; Esc cancels a question or closes a window.
help.ctl.mouse.bar.desc: Every button presses the matching key: menus, direction pad, the commands of the moment, Enter, Esc.
help.ctl.mouse.type.desc: Opens a field to type a word or a name (talking, mantras, Yell…) and sends it.
help.ctl.touch.person.desc: A menu offers to talk or to attack.
help.ctl.touch.swipe.desc: In dungeons: swipe up/down to step, left/right to turn.
help.ctl.touch.bar.desc: The command bar and the Type… button work as with the mouse; Type… brings up the on-screen keyboard.
help.q.goal: You are not here to defeat a tyrant. Britannia is at peace, but its people seek a model to follow: someone who lives by all eight virtues. Grow into that person, then go down to the bottom of the deepest dungeon to reach the Codex of Ultimate Wisdom.
help.q.virtues: Honesty, Compassion, Valor, Justice, Sacrifice, Honor, Spirituality and Humility. The game watches how you behave: giving to beggars, fighting bravely, sparing fleeing foes, paying fair prices and not boasting raise your standing; stealing, cheating merchants, fleeing a fight or killing the harmless lower it. There is no score on screen: ask the wise for advice on your progress.
help.q.talk: Talk (T) to a person and type a word. Everyone answers NAME, JOB, HEALTH and LOOK; BYE ends the chat. Some will JOIN your party; others will gladly accept gold if you GIVE it. The rest is up to you: when someone mentions a word that sounds important, try asking about it. Only the first four letters count. Write down what you learn: the game will not keep notes for you.
help.q.shrines: Each virtue has a shrine somewhere in the land, each with its own mantra. People will tell you the mantras. To enter a shrine you must carry its rune; meditate there for a number of cycles and chant the mantra. When you are truly ready in that virtue, you will be granted a vision and be elevated.
help.q.runes: The runes are hidden in or near the towns of each virtue: listen to the locals, then Search the right spot. The dungeons hold coloured stones, also needed later.
help.q.moons: Two moons, Trammel and Felucca, cycle through their phases (shown at the top of the screen). Moongates appear in certain places as the moons turn; where a gate leads depends on the phases. Learning the pattern lets you cross the land in a step.
help.q.save: Q saves the game, but only on the overworld: not in a town, a dungeon or a fight. Save often before taking risks.
help.q.tips: Buy food and keep an eye on it. Visit the castle of Lord British: he heals and advises. Mix spells before you need them. Recruit companions: each one stands for a virtue.
